note: RFC 4271 Section 6.3 defines NEXT_HOP syntactic correctness as a valid IP host address; RFC 7606 Sections 3(e) and 7.3 replace session reset with treat-as-withdraw. TestSessionRFC4271RevisedAttributeErrors drives Session.ReadAndProcess over net.Pipe with a 4-octet multicast NEXT_HOP (224.0.0.1) and valid ORIGIN/AS_PATH/NLRI (plus a 3-octet length case), preceded and followed by valid unicast NEXT_HOP updates; it asserts the exact synthesized withdrawal body, session survival, and accepted NLRI on the unicast control. Producer validateNextHopAttr enforces 4-octet length and unicast host range.
